lei.label: Lei (Act of the Assembleia da República)

hierarchy.note: Codes only (Código Civil, Código Penal, Código do Trabalho). Not used in ordinary leis.
Rare; appears in some codes as top-level grouping equivalent to Livro, or as a sub-Livro grouping.
Higher division within Capítulo in codes. CAUTION: in Portuguese law, Secção is above Artigo, not the basic unit — opposite of Anglophone usage. Do not confuse with section-as-basic-unit.
Higher division within Secção in codes. Rare outside large codes.
Ordinal with degree mark: Artigo 1.º, Artigo 2.º. Numbered continuously throughout the act regardless of chapter structure. Inserted articles use dash-letter suffix: Artigo 5.º-A → eid art_5A.
Numbered subdivision within an artigo. Arabic cardinal with full stop: 1., 2., 3. Cited as 'n.º 1 do artigo 5.º'. Maps to AKN paragraph. See unresolved ambiguity #1 re paragraph vs subsection.
Lettered subdivision within n.º (or directly within artigo when no n.º). a), b), c). Cited as 'alínea a)'.
Roman numeral subdivision within alínea. i), ii), iii). Cited as 'subalínea i)'. eId normalises Roman to Arabic: indent_1, indent_2.

hcontainers.name: preambulo
hcontainers.note: Explanatory preamble in Decretos-Lei. Lengthy rationale before the enacting formula. Published in the DR as part of the DL but not formally enacted. Model as hcontainer within <preamble> or as <preamble> body paragraphs.

dl.label: Decreto-Lei (Decree-Law of the Government)

hierarchy.note: Higher division within Capítulo. See note in 'lei' class.

dl.note: Decretos-Lei have constitutional force equal to Leis (CRP art. 112.º). Both are primary legislation. Distinguished from Leis by enacting authority (Government vs Assembleia) and FRBR URI subtype (/dl/). Typically preceded by a discursive explanatory preamble (preâmbulo) before the enacting formula.

lo.label: Lei Orgânica (Organic Law)
lo.note: Organic laws require absolute majority of Deputies in full plenary. Govern political parties, elections, referenda, military law, states of emergency, and other constitutionally designated matters. Same structure as Leis.

portaria.label: Portaria (Ordinance — ministerial regulatory act)
portaria.note: Portarias are signed by one or more Ministers. Published in Diário da República Série I. Subordinate to Leis and Decretos-Lei. Modern numbering includes Série: Portaria n.º NN/YYYY/1. No formal enacting formula — opens with enabling authority reference.

constitution.label: Constituição da República Portuguesa

hierarchy.note: The Constitution uses Títulos as the primary top-level division (e.g., Título I – Princípios Gerais).
Used in some parts of the Constitution as subdivision of Capítulo.

constitution.note: Constitution of 1976 (7th revision 2005). Top-level divisions are Partes (Parte I–IV) and then Títulos within each Parte. 296 articles. Artigos numbered continuously 1–296 across all Partes and Títulos.

frbr.number_note: Sequential number within the year per instrument type. Supplementary acts in same DR issue use dash-letter suffix: Lei n.º 45-A/2024 → year=2024, number=45-A. DLs and Leis have independent number series. Older DLs (Estado Novo) use large sequential numbers/two-digit year: DL 47 344/66 → year=1966, number=47344.
frbr.eli_note: ELI Pillar II implemented 2017-07-27. Store ELI URI as <FRBRalias> in metadata. All Série I acts from 2 January 1991 have ELI identifiers.

enacting_formulae.text: A Assembleia da República decreta, nos termos da alínea c) do artigo 161.º da Constituição, o seguinte:
enacting_formulae.translation: The Assembly of the Republic enacts, pursuant to subparagraph c) of Article 161 of the Constitution, the following:
enacting_formulae.note: Constitutional reference varies: alínea c) for ordinary legislation; different subparagraphs for organic laws, authorisations, etc.

enacting_formulae.text: A Assembleia da República decreta, nos termos da alínea c) do artigo 161.º e do n.º 2 do artigo 166.º da Constituição, a seguinte lei orgânica:
enacting_formulae.translation: The Assembly of the Republic enacts, pursuant to subparagraph c) of Article 161 and paragraph 2 of Article 166 of the Constitution, the following organic law:

enacting_formulae.text: O Governo decreta, nos termos da alínea a) do n.º 1 do artigo 198.º da Constituição, o seguinte:
enacting_formulae.translation: The Government enacts, pursuant to subparagraph a) of paragraph 1 of Article 198 of the Constitution, the following:
enacting_formulae.note: Constitutional reference varies by the legislative competence invoked. Article 198.º governs government legislative competence.

enacting_formulae.text: A Assembleia Constituinte, reunida na sessão plenária de 2 de Abril de 1976, aprova e decreta a seguinte Constituição da República Portuguesa:
enacting_formulae.translation: The Constituent Assembly, meeting in plenary session of 2 April 1976, approves and enacts the following Constitution of the Portuguese Republic:

amendments.substitution_phrasing: passa a ter a seguinte redação:
amendments.addition_phrasing: É aditado ... o artigo N.º-A, com a seguinte redação:
amendments.repeal_phrasing: É revogado o artigo N.º do [citation].
amendments.multiple_amendment_phrasing: Os artigos N.º, N.º e N.º do [citation] são alterados e passam a ter a seguinte redação:

structuring.prompt_additions: Portugal uses ARTICLE (Artigo) as the basic unit — never SECTION as basic unit. The hierarchy for ordinary legislation is CHAPTER (Capítulo, Roman numerals) > ARTICLE (Artigo N.º, e.g. 'ARTICLE 1'). For large codes, BOOK (Livro) > TITLE (Título) > CHAPTER (Capítulo) > SECTION (Secção, higher division only) > ARTICLE. SECTION here is a higher division containing ARTICLEs, not the basic unit. Numbered article subdivisions (n.º) use PARAGRAPH (e.g. 'PARA 1'). Lettered items (alínea a)) use POINT. Roman-numeral sub-items (subalínea i)) use INDENT. Artigo numbers include ordinal mark: 'Artigo 1.º', 'Artigo 2.º' — strip the '.º' for the Bluebell number. Inserted articles have dash-letter suffix: 'Artigo 5.º-A' → 'ARTICLE 5A'. Article headings (epígrafes) appear in parentheses after the number: 'Artigo 1.º (Objeto)' — the heading text in parentheses maps to <heading>. Many Decretos-Lei have no article headings — do not error. The enacting formula for a Lei is 'A Assembleia da República decreta, nos termos da alínea c) do artigo 161.º da Constituição, o seguinte:' and for a DL 'O Governo decreta, nos termos da alínea a) do n.º 1 do artigo 198.º da Constituição, o seguinte:' — both go inside PREAMBLE. The lengthy explanatory preâmbulo before the enacting formula in DLs also goes in PREAMBLE as body paragraphs before the formula.
